title: Leveraging Online Olympiad-Level Math Problems for LLMs Training and Contamination-Resistant Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on mathematical reasoning capabilities of LLMs, specifically using Olympiad-level problems. It introduces a training dataset (AoPS-Instruct) and an evaluation benchmark (LiveAoPSBench) to address data contamination, but it does not deal with religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
